intro.summary: Inner-city southwest community on the hillside south of 17 Avenue SW and west of 14 Street, mostly apartments and condos with some detached homes.
intro.body: Bankview climbs the hillside south of 17 Avenue SW and west of 14 Street SW, so many of its streets look east over the Beltline and downtown. Apartments and condos make up most of its housing. Detached and semi-detached homes are a minority, scattered among the walk-ups.
